outcome: State plainly, where an operator will read it, that the usage ledger accounts only for invocations the Loop makes through its own runner, so a hand-run command is invisible to it, and record the disclosed out-of-ledger invocations.
non_goals: Do not claim the ledger can observe a command run outside the Loop
Do not add a mechanism that would require intercepting the operator's own shell
Do not restate the runbook's operating instructions elsewhere

transitions.reason: the implementer disclosed that six Provider invocations made by hand before the ledger was wired never entered it, which shows the guard covers the Loop's execution path and not a person or an agent running the command directly
